title.zh: 宣布每年9月9日为宿务市与宿务省特别非工作公共假日、其他地区特别工作公共假日，以纪念已故总统Sergio Osmeña，Sr.
title.en: An Act Declaring September Nine of Every Year a Special Non-Working Public Holiday in the City of Cebu and the Province of Cebu With Its Component Cities and a Special Working Public Holiday in the Rest of the Country, in Honor of the Late President Sergio Osmeña, Sr., amending thereby Batas Pambansa Bilang 937

text.en: September Nine of every year is hereby declared a special non-working public holiday in the City of Cebu and the Province of Cebu with its component cities and a special working public holiday in the rest of the country, in honor of the late President Sergio Osmeña, Sr.
Batas Pambansa Bilang 937 is hereby amended accordingly.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days following its publication in two (2) national newspapers of general circulation.
